name: Barney 'The Barrel' Barkwood

greeting: Waterproof barrels! Guaranteed not to leak! Or your money back!
Barney Barkwood, at your service! Need something water-tight?
The Mire demands quality barrels! Lucky for you, that's all I sell!
Fresh batch just treated! Smell that pine tar! Beautiful!
Don't trust cheap barrels in swamp country! Trust Barkwood!
Leaky barrel? I can fix it! No barrel? I can sell you one!
Quality containment since before the Big Flood!
Barrels! Barrels! Get your waterproof barrels!
dialog.barrel_types: Got storage barrels, got shipping barrels, got 'hide-your-valuables-from-bandits' barrels! All waterproof! All guaranteed!
dialog.waterproofing_process: Secret family recipe! Pine tar, swamp wax, and a little something extra. Trade secret. But it works! Nothing gets through my barrels!
dialog.backstory: Came from a long line of coopers. My cousin in the Dustbelt - Bob - he sells regular barrels. I specialize. The Mire needs waterproof, and waterproof is what I deliver.
rumors: The dock bosses fight over everything. Including who buys barrels from who. Ridiculous.
That barrelgob claims to have seen a walking barrel. My barrels don't walk. I check them daily.
The foodboys store their ingredients in competitor barrels. Leaked all over last week. Should've come to me.
Heard the snakecharmer keeps Mr. Whiskers in a barrel at night. Hope it's one of mine.

time_of_day.morning: Morning treatment session. Nothing beats fresh pine tar in the morning.
time_of_day.noon: Lunch rush! People need barrels at all hours!
time_of_day.evening: Evening inspections. Every barrel checked personally.
time_of_day.night: Closed! Barrels need their beauty sleep too!

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: Disaster! A shipment of my finest barrels went overboard in the storm! They're floating out there in the Deep Muck, probably beached somewhere. Expensive merchandise! Help me recover them?
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Five premium waterproof barrels, branded with my mark. Should be floating in the Deep Muck somewhere. Please find them!
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: Any sign of my barrels? They're distinctive - dark oak with my 'BB' brand.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: MY BARRELS! All accounted for! And still waterproof! I knew my construction would hold! Here, take this - my finest mini-barrel. Perfect for adventuring! Keeps supplies dry guaranteed!

party_reactions.kade: Finally, someone who understands the value of proper storage.
party_reactions.nix7: Container specifications: optimal. Waterproofing integrity: 98.7%. Acceptable.
party_reactions.twist: Can I hide in a barrel? Like in the stories? Please?
party_reactions.korr: Quality craftsmanship. I appreciate attention to detail.
party_reactions.renna: The waterproofing enchantment is subtle but effective. He doesn't even know he's using magic.
party_reactions.suresh: A barrel that keeps water out. In the Mire. Truly valuable.
party_reactions.sova: Good for storing arrows. And other things.
party_reactions.grit: Had waterproof barrels in the army. Saved our supplies more than once.
party_reactions.ashka: The wood treatment resists fire too. Impressive.
party_reactions.senna: Good for smuggling. Not that I'd know. But good.
party_reactions.callum: They float! That's so cool! Barrel boats!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First barrel's at full price. Second one? Also full price. Quality costs.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again! Knew you'd appreciate quality waterproofing!
relationship_dialog.friend: For you? I have something special in the back. Extra watertight.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've earned the Barkwood family discount. Ten percent. Don't tell my cousin Bob.

cross_npc_connections: barrelman_wood_dustbelt: Cousin Bob. Regular barrels. Different market. We don't talk much.
pigman_brown: The tavern keeper. Stores his ale in my barrels. Smart man.
barrelgob_green: That goblin keeps hanging around my shop. Claims barrels 'speak' to him. Weird.
